issues.code_snippet:
When using pipes, prepend `set -o pipefail &&` to fail if any command fails:

```dockerfile
RUN set -o pipefail && curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash
```

Without this, a failed `curl` would be masked by a successful `bash`.
